_provenance.what: Real coordinates of for-sale homes in the Washington DC / Silver Spring MD metro.
_provenance.source: Zillow public map-search structured data, read through the user's own signed-in browser.
_provenance.capturedBy: A separate tracker build on the user's machine; exported from its SQLite AppState cache and supplied for this test.
_provenance.fieldsKept: zpid, lat, lng only - the geometry the harvester partitions on. No price, beds, or other property facts are used here.
_provenance.why: The subdivision logic must be proven against a real market's density, which is uneven in a way invented points are not.
